description: Measure a page for some seconds (after optional steps): draw calls and triangles per frame, shader programs, geometries and textures (exact, the same on every GPU), JS heap, and frame-time percentiles with the slowest frames and their cause (shader compile, GPU upload, draw calls, JS). Checks `budget` and compares with the last run of the same name (kept in .threesmith/perf/). Frame times come from software rendering: use them before/after on the same machine, not as real fps. Measure before and after every performance change.

budget.description: limits: frameMs (p95), calls and triangles (max per frame), textures, geometries, programs

name.description: name of the measurement for the comparison (default: the entry file)

root.description: folder to serve when the page needs files above its own folder

save.description: keep this run for the next comparison (default true)

target.description: Folder with the page (index.html), or the http(s) URL of a running dev server.

name: three_perf
title: Measure frames, draw calls and GPU resources
